definitions.reference_binding: The entity and its fixed canonical known-evaluation A or B payload (training table payload indices 2e and 2e+1); reference_world is an evaluation label, not necessarily its branch assignment during rebind training.
definitions.target_supervised_sequences: Count only when this entity is ep.targets and this exact payload is assigned to it in that sample own A or B branch. One such occurrence is one supervised sequence, irrespective of token length.
definitions.target_branches: A rebind reference binding may be supervised in the A branch, B branch, or both across epochs; the total sums both actual training branches.
definitions.not_counted: Background bank residency, copies in other targets independent banks, writer-cache precomputation and initialization-statistics use are NOT counted as target supervision.
definitions.zero_meaning: Zero means no sequence directly supervised this exact entity+payload binding as its target. It does NOT imply the support text was never encoded, resident as background, used in statistics, or exposed indirectly through retrieval.
definitions.experimental_scope: Post-hoc training-log audit only; does not alter frozen selection, test splits, loss, schedules or reported denominators.
